To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the temperature of the wheel hub drive has a strong influence on the motor efficiency.
the influence of temperature on the motor parameters can be neglected for the considered load cycles.
the temperature of the wheel hub drive has a significant impact on the efficiency of the motor, which leads to a higher energy consumption.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of the motor temperature on the motor efficiency, the required torque and the required power.
the development of a thermal-electromagnetic simulation model of an electric motor for a wheel hub drive.

the following aspects: - Calculation of the characteristic loss map of the wheel hub drive motor at different temperatures - Calculation of the temperature distribution of the motor at different temperatures using a thermal model - Calculation of the energy consumption of the wheel hub motor at different temperatures for the different load cycles The calculation of the energy consumption for the different load cycle is done using a coupled electromagnetic and thermal model of the wheel hub.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the energy consumption of an electric vehicle with an integrated wheel hub drive increases significantly with the temperature of the machine, but that the influence on the energy consumption is dependent on the driving cycle.
the temperature of the motor is of high significance for the energy consumption of an electric vehicle.
the influence of temperature is very high, and therefore should not be neglected.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the temperature of the machine has a significant impact on the energy consumption.
the temperature has a significant influence on the energy consumption of the wheel hub drive.
, for a wheel hub drive, a higher temperature leads to an increased energy consumption.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the influence of the rotor temperature on the characteristic loss maps is more pronounced than the influence of the winding temperature.
the temperature of the wheel hub drive is an important factor for the energy consumption of electric vehicles and should therefore be taken into account for the design of electric drives.
the energy consumption of an electric wheel hub drive can be reduced by 2.5% by taking into account the temperature dependence of the motor.
